messages:
rebecca: Quick heads-up 1: planning a short coord sesh on image provenance + KMS signing before the compliance review. Goals: per-repo keys, Rekor retention, admission verification, and an incident play for key compromise. Who's available?
omar: I can join. FYI we have an old deploy signer key in projects/infra/keys/deploy-signer that is too broad.
lee_build: @omar can you link the current IAM binding? We should see who actually has signer.setPolicy.
omar: pasted: projects/infra/keys/deploy-signer -> members: cloud-build-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com, infra-ops@redwood.com (owner).
priya_prodsec: Strong preference for per-repo KMS keys + a small service account per-pipeline. That lets us rotate without service disruption. Also need cosign+rekor CI steps and attestation metadata (builder id, git_sha, base_image_digest).
audit-bot: vulnerability scan: base-202305 contains libssl CVE-2023-ABCD, severity: high. Auto-flagged.
ralph_sre: For Rekor retention, suggest 6 months hot + cold archive to GCS, immutable retention 2y for compliance. Admission webhook should verify Rekor log inclusion and signature chain.
lee_build: Proposed CI flow: build->sbom gen (syft)->cosign attest+sign -> push image -> on success, emit canonical event to logger-audit-prod and copy SBOM/attest to gs://artifacts-sbom/<repo>/<commit>.
priya_prodsec: Event fields: event_type, repo, commit, image_digest, signer_key_id, signer_identity, rekor_index, sbom_url, attest_url, build_id, timestamp. Retention 1y searchable.
rebecca: Action items:
- omar: enumerate current keys and owners (ETA EOD).
- lee_build: CI changes + example cosign commands + sample Rekor payload (ETA tomorrow).
- priya_prodsec: draft admission controller policy and key compromise runbook (ETA Mon).
- ralph_sre: Rekor retention + archive plan + logger-audit-prod sink schema (ETA EOD).
lee_build: sample cosign snippet for CI:
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign generate-key-pair --kms projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/repo-abc-key
cosign sign --key kms://projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/repo-abc-key gcr.io/redwood/repo-abc@sha256:...
cosign attest --type grafeas --key kms://projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/repo-abc-key gcr.io/redwood/repo-abc@sha256:...
```
omar: per-repo keys sounds good. Need IAM template for build SA: roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner on that key and role to write Rekor entry.
priya_prodsec: Also add a policy: if critical CVE present in SBOM, fail build and create a priority rebuild task. Add canary rollout steps for base-image replacements.
ralph_sre: Note: admission webhook must tolerate signed-but-unregistered keys during rollout window. Have fallback path to quarantine and notify infra.
rebecca: Who owns the key compromise runbook?
priya_prodsec: I'll own it and work with seceng + SRE. Outline: immediate revoke key, mark images signed by that key as suspect, trigger force-rebuild pipeline for affected repos, notify customers and CRO as needed.
lee_build: created infra ticket INFRA-9402 for CI changes and artifact sink. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-9402
omar: I'll list keys in that ticket.
rebecca: Thanks. Meeting in 30 to review designs. If you can't make it, drop notes here. :thumbsup:
